recycle.title: Recycle bin
recycle.lead: Items, customers, suppliers, categories and expense heads deleted by mistake can be put back here. Only things never used can be deleted; anything with bills, stock or a balance is marked inactive instead, so no history is ever lost.
recycle.confirm: Delete "{{name}}"? It goes to the recycle bin (Settings → Recycle bin) and can be restored from there.
recycle.emptyCategoriesHelp: A category with no items left can be deleted.
